column1: # Chapter layout as Tutor-Board reads it.
# Columns (TAB separated):  num  slug  title
# WHY THIS EXISTS SEPARATELY FROM units.tsv. units.tsv is this repository's own
# single source of truth and carries BOTH tracks -- the eighteen Mathematica
# lessons and the seven Beltrami chapters -- in a four-column shape its own
# scripts read. Tutor-Board reads a three-to-five column chapters.tsv and has no
# idea what a "kind" column is, so it was falling back to guessing chapters from
# the chapters/chNN-* directory names. That works, but the titles it recovers are
# the slugs, which come out lower-cased and hyphen-derived: "Ch 1 - simple
# dynamic models". These are the same titles units.tsv carries, spelled properly.
# The rows below are GENERATED FROM units.tsv -- the chapter rows of it, in
# order. If a chapter is added there, add it here too, or the board will show the
# old list. units.tsv stays the source of truth; this is a view of it.
# THE LESSONS ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and this is a limitation worth knowing
# about rather than a decision. Tutor-Board labels every entry here as
# "Ch <num> - <title>", so a lesson listed here reads "Ch L01 - Lesson 01".
# There is no way in this format to say "not a chapter". So the board's contents
# menu offers the seven Beltrami chapters and not the eighteen lessons; a lesson
# sitting is opened by label instead:
#     board open "Mathematical Modeling" "Lesson 01" --lecture
# Titles here are Dr. Doty's, read off the section headings inside the notebooks,
# and are NOT Beltrami's chapter titles. README.md carries the map between them.
